title: Marketplace Pricing Scientist (6 months contract)
description:
About the role
Our dynamic pricing is rule-based today - conditional logic on surface signals like weather and supply-demand ratios. It works, but it's rigid, and we think it's leaving money on the table.
Our platform team is strong on data engineering and business analysis. What we don't have in-house is the applied economics or algorithmic depth to work out which pricing models are actually right for us. Other platforms have solved versions of this already. We want someone who can tell us which approach fits, prove it on our data, and hand it to our engineers to build.
6-month contract, fully remote and open to candidates anywhere , reporting to the Director, Platform.
What you will deliver

• A read on our existing pricing logic, with a number on the revenue and matching efficiency we're currently giving up

• A shortlist of approaches - mechanism design (VCG-style allocation), algorithmic search (optimal tree search, MCTS), predictive and ML pricing models - weighed against our data maturity, latency limits and commercial goals

• A recommended model, tested offline on GoGoX order and supply data, with the assumptions and failure modes spelled out

• An experiment design for live testing, including guardrails against cannibalising users or driver-partners, and the metrics that call it a win

• A handover pack our data engineers can build from, plus an honest view of what we'd need to hire or train for to own this long term

Who you are

• 5+ years applying economic or optimisation modelling to pricing, matching or incentives in a live two-sided marketplace - ride-hailing, logistics, delivery, travel or e-commerce

• Comfortable across mechanism design, causal inference (diff-in-diff, regression discontinuity, synthetic control), demand elasticity and structural modelling, and modern ML approaches to pricing

• Strong in Python and SQL, and happy working in production data next to engineers rather than handing over a paper

• Master's or PhD in Economics, Operations Research, Statistics or similar - or the industry track record that stands in for it

• Pragmatic about constraints. You recommend what works with the data and engineering we have, not what's most elegant

• Can explain the economics to a commercial audience. We can't act on a recommendation we can't interrogate

• Fluent spoken Cantonese

As the Engineering Lead for the CCM platform, you will set the technical direction and engineering standards across a set of interconnected applications - spanning greenfield development, enterprise scaling of existing applications, and integration with vendor and internal systems. You will serve as a Solution Lead, starting with a newly formed discovery team and continuing as the platform expands into dedicated delivery teams.
This role combines technical leadership with hands-on engineering (approximately 40-50% coding). The ideal candidate is an experienced solution or engineering lead who enjoys building new platforms, keeps teams honest on engineering practices, and is energized by shaping a multi-year transformation of how Mutual of Omaha communicates with its customers.

• Engineer II - $125,000 - $140,000, plus annual bonus opportunity

•

AI-Enabled Engineering: Champion the use of AI tools and agents to accelerate development, improve code quality, and increase team productivity.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

title: Cloud Network Engineer
description:
Cloud Network Engineer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Cloud Network Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000-$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 10+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking a Cloud Networking Engineer to design, deploy, and operate cloud networking infrastructure across one or more major cloud providers. The role covers VPC/VNet design, hybrid connectivity, transit topologies, edge networking, DNS, and the security controls that make cloud networking reliable and safe at scale. The ideal candidate combines deep traditional networking knowledge with cloud-native networking patterns, has built production cloud networks at meaningful scale, and brings strong automation discipline to networking work. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners - product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders - to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and operate cloud networking architectures including VPC/VNet, subnets, routing, and security groups.

• Build transit hub topologies using AWS Transit Gateway, Azure Virtual WAN, or GCP Network Connectivity Center.

• Design and implement hybrid connectivity using Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, Cloud Interconnect, and VPN.

• Architect edge networking including CDN, global load balancing, and WAF integration.

• Implement DNS strategies including Route 53, Azure DNS, or Cloud DNS with hybrid resolution.

• Design private connectivity to managed services using PrivateLink, Private Endpoints, or Private Service Connect.

• Automate cloud networking with Terraform, providing infrastructure-as-code coverage across the network estate.

• Implement network security controls including firewalls, NACLs, security groups, and DDoS protection.

• Operate Kubernetes networking including CNI selection, ingress strategies, and service exposure patterns.

• Build observability for cloud networking including flow logs, traffic insights, and packet capture.

• Drive cost optimization including data transfer reduction and right-sizing of network resources.

• Partner with security teams to harden the network perimeter and enforce zero-trust principles.

• Troubleshoot complex cloud networking issues across cloud and hybrid environments.

• Stay current with cloud networking platform updates and emerging patterns.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Networking, or a related field.

• Ten or more years of experience in networking, with significant time on cloud networking.

• Deep hands-on experience with networking on at least one major cloud provider.

• Strong understanding of routing, switching, BGP, and modern networking fundamentals.

• Hands-on experience with hybrid connectivity (Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, or equivalents).

• Experience with infrastructure-as-code for cloud networking, especially Terraform.

• Strong understanding of cloud security and network controls.

• Familiarity with Kubernetes networking and service mesh fundamentals.

• Strong troubleshooting and packet-level analysis skills.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

title: Cyber Risk and Compliance Specialist
description:
As a global medtech company, we are driven by our Vision of changing the trajectory of lives for a new day and our Mission to create ingenious solutions that ignite patient turnarounds. Our relentless commitment to patients and strong legacy of innovation in healthcare are the foundation of our future. If you're looking for a new chance, a new beginning, a new trajectory, LivaNova is where your talent can truly thrive. Join our talented team members worldwide to become a pioneer of tomorrow-because at LivaNova , we don’t just treat conditions - we aspire to alter the course of lives.
The Role
As our Cyber Risk and Compliance Specialist, you will occupy a critical role that is 50% technical auditor and 50% security advocate. You will ensure the integrity of our financial systems through IT SOX compliance while simultaneously maturing our global compliance posture (HIPAA/NIS2) and building a high-integrity security culture through a comprehensive Security Awareness program.

Focus A: IT SOX & Financial Integrity (60%)

•
Program Ownership : Lead the IT SOX program and design, implement, and test IT General Controls (ITGCs), IT Application controls (ITACs) and Key Reports (IPE) across our enterprise applications, databases, and infrastructure.

• Audit Management : Serve as the primary "translator" between technical teams and external auditors, ensuring evidence is accurate, timely, and defensible.
• Deficiency Management: Lead the root-cause analysis for any control failures and partner with stakeholders to build long-term, remediation plans.

Focus B: HIPAA, NIS2 & Risk Advisory (30%)
• Healthcare Compliance (HIPAA): Act as the technical SME for the HIPAA Security Rule, ensuring controls protect PHI, including controls monitoring and providing guidance to management for new systems.
• International Resilience (NIS2): Lead the alignment of our security posture with the NIS2 Directive, focusing on key areas in the directive for our European operations.
• Strategic Risk Assessments: Conduct deep-dive risk assessments for new technologies and vendors, ensuring compliance is baked in from the procurement stage.

Focus C: Security Awareness & Training (10%)
• Program Development: Manage the security awareness program that goes beyond "check-the-box" training. You will create engaging content for diverse audiences, from senior leadership to staff.
• Policy Promotion: Translate dense Information Security Policies into digestible, actionable "good practices" for IT administrators and data owners.
• Culture Building: Design targeted communication campaigns to increase internal reporting of security incidents and reinforce the importance of compliance.

Qualifications
• Experience: 5-7 years in IT Audit, IT Compliance, or Cyber Risk.
• Regulatory Knowledge: Expert-level understanding of SOX 404 (ITGCs) and a strong working knowledge of the HIPAA Security Rule and NIS2.
• Frameworks: Proficiency in applying NIST 800-53, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, or COBIT.

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
Flow Traders is looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Data Platform team in our Amsterdam office.

We are a leading proprietary trading firm with an entrepreneurial culture. We value sharp, creative engineers and give them the room and the responsibility to make full use of their abilities.

Your mission is to build and run the platform at the centre of the firm: the source of truth for our proprietary research data, the foundation every department builds on, and the context layer our AI agents depend on. You will make it the place where anyone, human or agent, can find trusted data, understand it, and build on it quickly and safely. Working closely with our Quants and research engineers, you will help shape how the firm does systematic trading.

What you will do

• Own performance at scale. Take ownership of the distributed systems, storage and processing platforms that power our data-intensive applications. You will push them to perform under real market load, from tuning a slow pipeline to designing monitoring and alerting that catches problems before our traders do.

• Build and maintain platform capabilities. Design and maintain the products our users rely on every day: self-provisioned compute, scheduling, transformations, ad-hoc exploration. Treat quants, analysts and other teams as customers of a platform product.

• Make the hard design calls. Be part of the group that shapes the data landscape at Flow Traders. Decide on data modelling, storage formats and processing patterns, weighing performance, cost and maintainability.

• Run what you build. Keep it reliable on busy days, continuously improve resource usage and cost; investigate and resolve data issues and pipeline failures; build operational tooling and runbooks.

• Enable governance and context for AI. Build and maintain the tools that make good governance possible across the firm, such as our data catalog, lineage, access control and configurable data quality rules, and promote their adoption.

• Co-develop with AI, responsibly. Use coding agents daily to design, write, test and review code, while owning the correctness of everything that ships.

• Raise the bar around you. Mentor engineers through code reviews, design discussions and pairing, including how to work effectively and critically with AI tools.

What you need to succeed

Required

• 8+ years building and operating multiple data platforms in production, across different domains. You have made mistakes along the way and can explain what you would do differently.

• You reason from fundamentals (storage layouts, query execution, networking, distributed systems behavior) when designing systems.

• You are comfortable making trade-offs between latency, cost, consistency and simplicity, and can defend them to engineers and business users alike.

• Strong data modelling and data warehousing experience, including analytical engines (e.g. BigQuery, ClickHouse).

• Extensive hands-on experience with distributed storage, messaging (e.g. Kafka, Pub/Sub), batch and stream processing (e.g. Apache Beam, Spark) and container orchestration (e.g. Kubernetes).

• Strong programming skills in Python and/or Java, with high standards for testing and code quality.

• Solid cloud experience across storage, databases (e.g. AlloyDB) and data processing, preferably GCP and AWS.

• Practical experience with data governance: ownership, lineage, access control, metadata management and data quality frameworks.

• Understanding of how AI systems consume data (retrieval, semantic layers, tool and agent interfaces) and what it takes to make data reliable context for them.

• You enjoy working with demanding internal users, translating vague needs into clear platform capabilities.

• You communicate clearly across technical and non-technical teams, and you like helping others grow.

• Interest in financial markets is a plus; prior trading experience is not required.

title: Staff Technical Program Manager (f/m/d)
description:
We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you.

Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future.

Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter.

Help us see what's possible. Join us.

YOUR ROLE

Orbem is at a critical inflection point. As we scale our range of unique products, we need delivery that is predictable, transparent and built to scale.

As a Staff Technical Program Manager within our TPM team, you will drive the delivery of complex, high-stakes programs that bring our products from development to market. You will work across Hardware, Software and Science/AI, aligning teams around shared goals and turning technical complexity into clear plans and decisions.

This is a high-impact role that blends technical depth, delivery architecture and informal leadership. You will work in a complex, fast-scaling environment, and you will also help strengthen how the wider TPM team works.

YOUR DAY-TO-DAY

Own the Execution Plan:

- Architect and design end-to-end delivery plans for your team(s), from initial discovery or design phase until commercial launch.

- Lead quarterly OKR planning and ensure it is fully aligned to company OKRs.

Lead Cross-Functional Coordination:

- Co-lead product delivery with the Product Manager and Tech Leads. You own the how and when.

- Manage dependencies across teams and relevant domains (technical, operations, business development), and keep stakeholders, including external partners, aligned.

Drive Risk & Decision-Making

- Proactively identify, track, and mitigate technical and non-technical risks - timeline, resources, budget, and scope.

- Escalate and resolve cross-team conflicts; create the decision-making frameworks other teams rely on.

Shape Ways of Working

- Champion tooling and process best practices within the team and contribute workflows optimization within the TPM team. (e.g. refine the Product Development Lifecycle, Risk Management processes).

- Coach and mentor other TPMs.

YOUR EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS

- Program Leadership: Proven track record managing complex, cross-functional technical programs - ideally spanning hardware, software, and/or AI - with high delivery accountability.

- Technical Depth: Solid understanding of how complex deep-tech products are engineered across Hardware, Software and Science/AI. You can evaluate trade-offs across all three domains well enough to challenge and guide engineering decisions. A technical background in systems engineering, MRI or AI/ML is a plus.

- Practical understanding of how products are operated at customer sites, from early MVPs to mature deployments.

- Execution & Planning: Expert in building and managing master program plans, sprint structures, milestone tracking, and risk registers across multiple concurrent workstreams.

Stakeholder Management: Able to translate technical complexity into executive-level clarity and to influence and align without formal authority across matrixed organizations.

- Change Management: Proven ability to drive adoption of new tools, frameworks, and processes (e.g. PDLC/PLM rollouts, agile tooling) across cross-functional teams - balancing structured change with the pace of a fast-moving scale-up.

- Tooling & Process: Advanced setup of planning and tracking tools such as Jira and Confluence, covering portfolio dashboards, cross-team dependency and risk tracking, and executive-ready reporting. Hands-on with agentic AI tools that boost team efficiency.

- Leadership & Culture: You are a servant leader who thrives in fast-growing scale-up

The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility - and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide.

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. As our Mobile Software Engineering Manager on the Audience Technology team, you will lead a highly collaborative team of mobile software engineers building, testing, and delivering award-winning features for NPR's flagship mobile applications. You will partner closely with our Product, Design, Data, and Editorial teams to identify priorities, architect new features, and continuously improve existing applications. Wonderly is a closed-loop, end-to-end system that self-improves on our customers’ revenue. Pre-AI SaaS sold tools. AI companies claim they sell outcomes - task done, call answered, lead booked, ticket resolved - but calls or leads aren’t the outcomes that ultimately matter. Revenue is what ultimately matters, and today, none of the AI companies actually promise revenue. Wonderly changes that.

Our 70-person team (mostly in PDE) spent over a year building in stealth; our thesis is that - if you actually want to control the end result (revenue) of a business and deploy AI fast/cheaply, you can’t just build the sexy part (agents), you must also build the unsexy parts and own everything end to end: the system of record layer and the application layer. We built from scratch every software a home service business needs - replacing ServiceTitan, Squarespace, Ringcentral, Jobber, Square, Hubspot, and a dozen others applications. And we built every agent necessary - AI marketing, AI receptionist, AI voice, AI sales outreach, AI sales coaching, AI follow-ups, AI 3D design, AI finance, AI quoting, AI collections, and more - all embedded inside our own system with native data access. As a result, we can deploy dozens of production-ready Agents to our customers in under 24 hours with no FDEs, no integrations, and no data cleaning work.

title: Head of ALM
description:
ABOUT ARQ

ARQ is one of the fastest-growing fintechs in the world. Our mission is to redefine how people interact with money across borders, building the infrastructure to move value seamlessly. We're still early in our journey, which means every person who joins shapes the future of our product, culture, and growth. If you're excited by big challenges, global impact, and the chance to grow fast with a world-class team, ARQ is the place to do it.

THE ROLE

As Head of Asset & Liability Management, you will oversee how ARQ funds, invests, and safeguards a rapidly expanding, multi-currency balance sheet. Our balance sheet spans multiple jurisdictions, currencies, banking partners, and payment rails-your core focus will be ensuring it remains secure, liquid, and optimally structured to drive financial return.

In this inaugural leadership role, you will build ARQ's ALM framework, risk policies, and governance committees from the ground up across approximately 10 regulatory licenses, partnering closely with Finance, Treasury, Risk, Product, and Compliance.

Collaborating with cross-functional leadership across Product, Finance, and Engineering, you will uphold safeguarding obligations across key global markets-including core Latin American operations (such as Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, and Mexico) alongside the US, UK, and Gibraltar-while securing capital adequacy and fund segregation. Operating as an influential individual contributor with high executive and board visibility, you will protect our financial core and maximize balance sheet efficiency as ARQ advances toward key strategic milestones and public readiness.

In your first 12 months, success looks like:

- A board-approved ALM policy with clear limits for liquidity, FX, interest-rate and counterparty risk

- A running ALCO with a monthly balance-sheet pack the leadership team trusts

title: Staff Product Manager, T:0 (Agentic Finance)
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

You’ll lead the creation of a new AI-native product for T:0 https://t0.ai, helping define how agentic finance can move beyond software and tooling into finance work itself.

You’ll take the product from 0 to 1, shaping the strategy, user experience, solution design, roadmap and delivery plan around real founder problems and customer needs.

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Design, Commercial and customers to validate the opportunity, find product-market fit and scale what works.

You’ll stay close to developments in AI, machine learning, LLMs, target markets and the competitive landscape, using those insights to guide product strategy and make high-quality decisions.

You’ll work from our San Francisco office three days a week.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Essentials

- 7+ years of overall professional experience.

- Experience in product management, including building products from 0 to 1.

- Demonstrated experience working in novel fields such as AI, machine learning or LLMs.

- Experience defining product strategy, user requirements and commercial approaches that drive meaningful product growth.

- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey product strategy to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with close attention to detail and the ability to structure complex problems using data and first-principles thinking.

- Drive, grit and persistence to take ownership and move ideas from concept to reality in short periods of time.

- Ability to work effectively across cross-functional and cross-cultural teams.

Preferred

- Previous experience as a startup founder or early joiner.

- Bachelor’s degree or higher in a STEM discipline.

YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

- You’re excited by a category that hasn't been won yet, and want to be early enough to shape it.

- You’re comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you’ll run with it.

- You’re comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

- You own the outcome and you don’t wait for permission to fix what’s broken.

- You’re not precious about your ideas. You push hard for what you believe in, but you pivot fast when the data says otherwise.

- You enjoy working closely with people across multiple countries and time zones as part of one connected, global team, including flexing your hours occasionally to make that connection work.

- You can advocate hard for a position, then fully support the team’s direction once a call is made.

- You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

title: Power Electronics Engineer
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE PRODUCT ENGINEERING TEAM

Product Engineering builds the power and cooling systems that let Fluidstack deliver gigawatt-scale AI data centers faster and denser than the grid-standard supply chain allows. The SST group is designing solid-state transformers as a core building block of that power architecture.

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Architect a medium-voltage solid-state transformer that can be manufactured, serviced, and scaled across gigawatt-scale campuses, not just demonstrated in a lab.

- Define the interface between the SST and the MVDC distribution system, including protection, control boundaries, and fault behavior.

- Build a semiconductor and magnetics supply strategy that survives a thin 10kV SiC market over a multi-year horizon.

- Take converter hardware from topology selection through working prototypes on a schedule that data center construction actually depends on.

ROLE SCOPE

- Design the SST cell and block in detail: converter implementation, component selection, magnetics interface, and loss and thermal budgets for a 5 MW block on a medium-voltage DC bus.

- Simulate, build and bring up the first cell prototypes with the PCB, firmware and test engineers, and debug them at full voltage and power.

- Turn the program's architecture decisions into a buildable design: schematics, design calculations, and the technical sections of the SST specification.

- Test vendor hardware and data against your own models, and give the program lead the technical evidence behind each make, co-develop or buy call.

- Carry the design through cell, block and pilot-unit design reviews, closing every open loss, thermal and insulation item before the next build.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would. https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c

- You've hands-on developed and validated high-power or medium-voltage power converters at the lab bench, going far beyond writing technical requirements.

- You've engineered isolated DC-DC converters utilizing 1.7 kV+ SiC devices and can rigorously justify your efficiency calculations.

- You've guided conversion systems from initial simulation models through hardware bring-up and full qualification testing.

title: Campaign Analyst
description: Onze missie is helder: beter eten voor meer mensen bereikbaar maken. Als Campaign Analyst in het Customer Retention team speel je hierin een cruciale rol door onze klanten beter vast te houden. Jij zorgt ervoor dat we al onze verhalen, over al onze producten, op de juiste manier aan de juiste klant vertellen. Je bent continu, datagedreven op zoek naar verbetering; zodat we het volgende verhaal nóg beter vertellen. Wat je gaat doen Onze retentiestrategie wordt steeds geavanceerder. We sturen niet simpelweg 'een korting' naar alle klanten maar werken met gelaagde acties, inspirerende verhalen en gepersonaliseerde extra’s. Enerzijds ben jij de analytische drijfkracht achter de executie van onze campagnes. Je bouwt, beheert en verbetert de analytische tooling en dashboards zodat we kunnen blijven leren. Daarmee creëer je begrip van - en grip op - de commerciële impact van campagnes, en alle onderliggende onderdelen (zoals kanaalstrategie, product-samenstelling of klantdoelgroep). Vervolgens vertaal je de verworven inzichten effectief naar succesfactoren, verbeteringstrajecten en/of toekomstige experimenten. Anderzijds werk je inhoudelijk mee. Je bepaalt samen met de Campaign Specialist welk aanbod naar welke klanten gaat, via welk kanaal en met welke verwachting en zet je ook (nieuwe) acties zelf op. Een aantal van jouw verantwoordelijkheden: Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de performance van campagnes. Je analyseert de impact, en je gebruikt inzichten om toekomstige campagnes te verbeteren, zodat we kunnen blijven innoveren in onze retentiestrategie. Je werkt actief mee met het team: je levert niet alleen de inzichten, maar bent ook zelf verantwoordelijk voor de implementatie van campagnes.

As a trusted partner to Brokers, at Manulife Bank, we deliver sophisticated lending solutions and financial strategies that don’t just grow wealth, they amplify it. Built on a foundation of excellence and driven by bold innovation, we empower Brokers to deepen relationships, unlock potential, and redefine success for their clients. We’re looking for visionaries who understand where banking is headed; those who can blend the precision of complex financial products with the possibilities of cutting-edge technology. Join us, and be part of a team where banking drives extraordinary outcomes.

The Manulife Bank Business Development Manager, Broker (BDM), serves as a senior relationship manager within a defined territory, responsible for driving mortgage sales by promoting the Bank’s full range of products and partnering with top-tier mortgage brokers. role will focus on building relationships, educating and training mortgage brokers on our unique mortgage product offering, and will look for look for opportunities to actively further promote other Bank offerings in the broker space.

Remote-based role with regular travel required within the assigned territory.

Position Responsibilities:

Individual Accountabilities

• Develop mortgage broker connections in designated location with strategic interactions according to business plan, acting as Bank mortgage resource. (40%)

• Optimize delivery of value-added products, service and advice while enhancing sales efforts through consultation and demonstrating the merits of integrated Bank products and services with a mortgage brokers business. Support mortgage brokers by working directly with centers of influence, accountants, real estate agents and participating in client seminars. (30%)

• Perform front line business risk management function through awareness, support and implementation of compliance and company policies with mortgage brokers, including supervision of sales related activities. Responsible for escalation of market conduct or compliance related concerns to the National Partnership Leader and Bank Compliance. (15%)

• Collaborate with other Managers at Manulife Bank to improve operational efficiencies and identify new product opportunities. (10%)

• Partner with other Manulife Financial and Manulife Bank representatives to build mortgage broker interests in Manulife Bank debt management, loan and deposit solutions. (5%)

Key Shared Accountabilities

• Coordinating Bank territory business development activities with other Manulife Bank representatives,

Required Qualifications:

• 7+ years of experience in banking or credit

• 5+ years in the mortgage broker environment

• Strong sales, negotiation, and customer service skills

• Excellent communication and presentation abilities (written, verbal, one-on-one, group)

• Highly organized, self-disciplined, and able to manage time and territory effectively

• Willingness and ability to travel within the assigned territory

Preferred Qualifications:

• Knowledge of Manulife Bank products, including Manulife One

• Familiarity with residential and commercial lending policies and practices

• Understanding of regulatory/legal issues in the mortgage space

• Experience with business planning and mentoring team members

• Industry designation (e.g., AMP) or working toward one

• Strong relationship-building skills, including conflict management and cross-functional collaboration

• As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
Are you excited to work with innovative security products?
Are you a security engineer who enjoys building robust defenses to help organizations stay safe?
Join Akamai Guardicore (Enterprise Security Group)
Akamai ExAR, within Akamai's Enterprise Security Group, focuses on advanced detection, threat intelligence, and proactive defense operations. Professionals passionate about building defenses, transforming research insights into actionable technical solutions, and directly supporting customers against active threats will thrive.
Partner with the best
You will serve as the technical bridge between our security research innovations and our global engineering operations. You will play a critical role in our customer-facing operations, delivering high-tier human support for Akamai ExAR. Acting as a trusted technical partner to our clients during advanced security investigations and critical events.
As a Security Engineer Senior, you will be responsible for:

• Investigating complex cyber-attacks to uncover adversary behaviors and support customer defenses.

• Designing and monitoring production-grade code for new detection methodologies across large-scale telemetry.

• Triaging high-severity incidents, presenting investigation findings, and providing advanced technical support to customers.

• Analyzing AI-generated detections and partnering with researchers to continuously refine their effectiveness.

• Applying actionable Threat Intelligence to identify tactical shifts and proactively enhance defensive coverage

• Working closely with globally dispersed teams to ensure seamless operational continuity and knowledge sharing.

Do what you love
To be successful in this role you will:

• Have 5+ years of cybersecurity experience spanning security engineering, cloud-native architectures, XDR platforms, and SOC environments

• Combine investigative intuition with engineering rigor to independently correlate diverse telemetry and disrupt threat actors.

• Write robust code (e.g., Python) to build, monitor, and maintain modern, scalable security data pipelines and have Advanced or Fluent English

• Partner with the Research team to translate threat intelligence into automated defenses using advanced scripting and APIs.

• Have a deep understanding of attacker TTPs, MITRE ATT&CK, network protocols, and OS internals.

• Leverage AI and machine learning to identify anomalies, mitigate active threats, and streamline complex detection workflows.

• Serve as a trusted technical advisor to explain AI-driven insights and implement customer-specific security solutions in fluent Japanese and business level English

Serve as a trusted technical advisor who can clearly explain AI-driven insights and implement customer-specific security solutions.

At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day.
Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.
Our focus is simple:
Cloud and Edge: Running apps closer to users for instant performance.
Security : Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.
Content Delivery : Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch.

title: Staff Product Designer
description:
WHY FACULTY?

We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here https://faculty.ai/impact.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

ABOUT FRONTIER

Faculty Frontier™ is a decision operating system. It puts AI to work on the decisions that matter most to large organisations, such as where to invest, how to allocate resources, and when to act.

Every enterprise is investing heavily in AI, but few are confident it will improve performance. Too often it goes to what’s easy to automate, disconnected from the decisions that actually move the business.

Frontier works backwards from objectives like revenue, margin and risk to the decisions that drive them, then connects the data, models and agents those decisions need into a world model of the business. Teams simulate and optimise options with ADA, our AI decision agent, and every decision is tracked against its outcome so the system keeps learning. Our ambition is to make business decisions as easy to navigate as getting around a city.

We don’t believe in AI that thinks for people. We believe in AI that helps people think, with humans and agents working together inside a decision system.

Customers start with one high-value decision and prove value in weeks. Over months they connect it into a wider decision network, and over years they build an adaptive enterprise.

Frontier is built by Faculty, an AI company that has delivered more than 400 systems since 2014 and is now part of Accenture.

ABOUT DESIGN AT FRONTIER

We’re a small team, growing deliberately - we’d rather have five designers who trust each other than fifteen who don't.

We're tightly integrated with engineering. We prototype in code. We co-own the design system with developers. We're actively exploring what agentic-augmented design work looks like in practice, not in think pieces - and we're honest when we don't have the answer yet.

We’re active in shaping the product culture at Frontier; putting people first, raising the quality bar and ensuring a coherent experience. You’ll be part of shaping that culture.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll be one of the most senior designers on Frontier, shaping a product that's still early enough that the decisions you make will define how it works for years.

Day to day, you'll be designing the surfaces where people and agents collaborate on real clinical decisions - how evidence gets surfaced, how recommendations get explained, how humans push back, how teams learn. This is hard, unsolved design work. The existing patterns for AI interfaces mostly come from consumer chat products; they don't transfer cleanly to environments where the cost of a bad decision is measured in years of research or patient outcomes.

You'll be expected to work end-to-end: from framing the problem with product and engineering, through prototyping in code and design canvases, through shipping. You'll help set the craft bar for the team, mentor the designers around you, and push back when something isn't good enough yet.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

- Designing the core interaction patterns for how humans and agents collaborate inside a decision loop.

- Making dense, analytical information legible for expert
